name: malformed-locator-stays-outside-the-typed-set
description: A URI with an empty session segment names no render locator, so it is not a read of one and the four classifications do not apply. The graded law is exactly one negative: the error carries NO resource-read code on error.data.code. The NUMBER is not graded, not even negatively — MCP assigns the resource-missing number to a resources/read of a URI the server does not serve, so a framework mapping every unrecognized URI onto it is correct and must not fail here. The classification alone keeps the two apart: a genuine miss carries NOT_FOUND and the constant message, a malformed URI carries no classification at all.
